jobs.description: Alert jobs: On-duty members of these jobs get alerts that name no jobs of their own.

alertSeconds.description: Alert time: How long an alert's blip and waypoint key stay, unless the alert names its own time.

cardSeconds.description: Card time: How long the alert card stays on screen.

maxAlerts.description: Live alerts per officer: Most alerts an officer keeps on the map at once; a new one replaces the oldest.

sound.description: Sound: A sound plays when a card comes in.

blip.description: Alert blip: Map blip of an alert whose script sets no blip of its own. High priority alerts flash.
